messages.S3「接客道四式 封心」で「邸宅の木霊」を付け、バトルパッシブでマッチ勝利ごとに: A Sinking applicator that inflicts Echoes of the Manor with S3 Reception Arts 4: Heartseal and adds 3 Sinking per clash win through her combat passive. S2 and S3 against enemies with Echoes also help sustain Sinking Count.
messages.S3「接客道四式 封心」: Ⅰコイン的中時に沈潜回数+3。Ⅳコイン的中時に次のタ: **S3 — Reception Arts 4: Heartseal**: On hit, Coin Ⅰ adds +3 Sinking Count. On hit, Coin Ⅳ inflicts 2 Echoes of the Manor next turn, and if the target already has Echoes, adds another +3 Sinking Count. Gains +2 Coin Power if the target has at least 5 Sinking Count.
messages.邸宅の木霊: スキル・コイン効果で沈潜の威力や回数が付与されるたび、50%の確率: **Echoes of the Manor**: Each time a skill or Coin effect inflicts Sinking Potency or Count, there is a 50% chance to add +1 Sinking Count. Changes the Panic Type of enemies with SP. Decreases by 1 at Turn End. Its value does not stack; it is overwritten.
messages.バトルパッシブ「バトラー式対応」(憂鬱×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): マッチ勝利: **Combat passive — Butler Style Response (4 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On Clash Win, inflicts 1 Sinking, 3 times per turn. Against targets with Echoes, it inflicts 3 instead.
messages.S2「招かざる客の出迎え」: Ⅱコインで沈潜回数+2/3。沈潜回数を維持する主力: **S2 — Interloper Reception**: Coin Ⅱ adds +2/3 Sinking Count. This is her main tool for maintaining Sinking Count.
messages.S1「押収」: 沈潜2を付与する。沈潜回数は増やせない。: **S1 — Confiscation**: Inflicts 2 Sinking. It cannot increase Sinking Count.
messages.S3で木霊を付け、次のターンからマッチに勝ってパッシブで沈潜3ずつを入れる。木霊: Mark a target with Echoes using S3, then from the next turn win Clashes so the passive inflicts 3 Sinking each time. Landing S3 again on an enemy that still has Echoes raises its Sinking Count by 6 in total. Top up Count with S2 and serve as the Count maintainer of a Sinking team. The passive requires Clash Wins, so she performs better in Clashes than in one-sided attacks.
